description: This file defines the LanguageNegotiator class responsible for handling language negotiation logic within Drupal, including managing negotiation methods, configuration, and language detection.

classes.name: Drupal\language\LanguageNegotiator
classes.description: Class responsible for performing language negotiation within Drupal, managing negotiation methods, configurations, and language detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LanguageNegotiator with dependencies such as language manager, plugin manager, config factory, settings, and request stack.

methods.name: initLanguageManager
methods.description: Initializes the injected language manager with this negotiator to avoid circular dependencies.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the negotiated languages and methods caches.

methods.name: setCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user and resets negotiation state.

methods.name: initializeType
methods.description: Performs language negotiation for a specific type, returning the negotiated language.

methods.name: getEnabledNegotiators
methods.description: Retrieves enabled negotiation methods for a given language type.

methods.name: negotiateLanguage
methods.description: Performs language negotiation using a specified method and type, returning the negotiated language object.

methods.name: getNegotiationMethods
methods.description: Returns available negotiation method definitions, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getNegotiationMethodInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of a negotiation method plugin.

methods.name: getPrimaryNegotiationMethod
methods.description: Returns the primary negotiation method for a given type.

methods.name: isNegotiationMethodEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific negotiation method is enabled for a given type.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the enabled negotiation methods configuration for a specific language type.

methods.name: purgeConfiguration
methods.description: Clears cached negotiation definitions and resets language configurations.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates language negotiation configurations based on provided types, handling default and locked settings.
